candidateNotFoundTitle: Candidate not found in this release
candidateNotFoundDescription: The candidate URL does not match the selected release.
noDecisionDescription: The assigned policy is waiting for its first deterministic evaluation.

projection.pendingDescription: Caselog is evaluating the assigned policy. No decision is synthesized while processing is incomplete.
projection.staleDescription: Newer evidence exists than the decision shown below. Request another evaluation before relying on it.
projection.failureRetriesExhausted: Automatic evaluation exhausted its retries. You can safely request another evaluation.
projection.failureUnknown: The evaluation could not complete. Request another evaluation or inspect the service diagnostics.

assignment.title: Assign a release policy
assignment.description: A candidate needs an immutable published policy version before Caselog can evaluate readiness.
assignment.readOnlyDescription: Ask a workspace owner, administrator, or lead to assign a published release policy.
assignment.noPublishedPolicies: This project has no published release policy. Create and publish a policy before assigning it.

gates.title: Gates
gates.orderNote: Needs attention first, then passed gates.
gates.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load complete gate details
gates.noSelectedEvidence: No evidence observation was selected for this gate.

explanations.comparisonPassed: The selected evidence satisfies the published gate expression.
explanations.comparisonFailed: The selected evidence does not satisfy the published gate expression.
explanations.missingEvidence: No matching evidence exists for this metric and test-run role.
explanations.incompleteEvidence: Matching evidence exists but is incomplete.
explanations.staleEvidence: Matching evidence expired before this evaluation.
explanations.untrustedEvidence: Matching evidence does not meet the gate's minimum trust level.

linkedRuns.title: Linked test runs
linkedRuns.empty: No test runs are linked to this candidate.

policies.title: Release policies
policies.description: Define versioned, deterministic gates for release-candidate decisions.
policies.emptyDescription: Create and publish a release policy before assigning one to a candidate.
policies.detailErrorTitle: Unable to load this release policy
policies.versionsDescription: Published and retired versions remain unchanged so historical decisions keep their exact inputs.
policies.draftNoticeDescription: This draft is not used for readiness decisions until you publish it. Publishing retires the current published version and preserves both versions in history.

successor.loadErrorTitle: Unable to load this release policy
successor.title: Create draft version {{version}}
successor.description: Create the next immutable configuration for {{name}} without changing its currently published version.
successor.existingDraftDescription: Review and publish the existing draft before creating another successor version.
successor.noPublishedDescription: A successor can only be cloned from the current published policy version.
successor.readOnlyDescription: A workspace lead, admin, or owner must create successor policy versions.
successor.cloneDescription: These gates are a working copy of published version {{version}}. Changes here do not affect that version.
successor.immutableTitle: The new draft is a complete version
successor.immutableDescription: Creating this draft stores the full ordered gate definition. Review it on the policy page and publish it explicitly when it is ready.

create.title: Create release policy
create.description: Define a stable policy identity and its first typed draft. The draft stays inactive until you explicitly publish it.
create.readOnlyDescription: A workspace lead, admin, or owner must create and publish release policies.
create.identityDescription: The key and name identify this policy across all of its immutable versions.
create.keyHint: Lowercase letters, numbers, and hyphens; for example production-readiness.
create.keyInvalid: Use 2–50 lowercase letters, numbers, or hyphens, starting with a letter.
create.name: Policy name
create.nameInvalid: Enter a policy name of at most 120 characters.
create.descriptionHint: Explain when this policy should be assigned and what promotion boundary it protects.
create.draftDescription: Every gate is evaluated in this order against server-owned evidence for the selected test-run role.
create.immutableDescription: Saving creates version 1 as a draft. Review it on the policy detail page, then publish it explicitly. Published versions and the decisions that used them are never edited in place.

editor.gatesDescription: Use only metrics and dimensions supported by the current evaluator contract.
editor.gateKeyHint: Stable lowercase identifier; dots, underscores, and hyphens are supported.
editor.gateKeyInvalid: Use 2–50 lowercase letters, numbers, dots, underscores, or hyphens, starting with a letter.
editor.gateKeyDuplicate: Gate keys must be unique within a policy version.
editor.expectedInvalid: Enter a value compatible with the selected metric.
editor.previewFailure: apply the selected impact when this comparison fails

evidence.title: Evidence for this candidate
evidence.empty: No current evidence observations exist for this candidate.

explorer.title: Evidence explorer
explorer.description: Inspect normalized observations and their provenance for one immutable release candidate. Filters are evaluated by the server across the full history.
explorer.candidateRequiredDescription: Open this page from Candidate Readiness or enter an exact candidate ID. Evidence is candidate-scoped so observations from different immutable artifacts are never mixed.
explorer.historyNoticeDescription: Superseded observations remain visible for audit and historical decision reconstruction. They are not current inputs for new evaluations.
explorer.emptyDescription: No evidence matches this candidate and filter set. Clear filters or verify that the producer has delivered evidence for the candidate.

filters.dateRangeInvalid: The end date must not precede the start date.

healthy.label: Usable evidence
healthy.description: This is a current, available, non-stale observation from an authenticated or verified producer. Individual policies may still require a higher trust level.

incomplete.label: Incomplete evidence
incomplete.description: The producer recorded an explicit incomplete observation, so a deterministic value is not available for this metric and dimension set.

stale.label: Stale evidence
stale.description: This observation has passed its server-owned expiry time and cannot silently satisfy a freshness-sensitive gate.

unverified.label: Unverified evidence
unverified.description: The producer is explicitly unverified. A policy requiring authenticated or verified evidence will not accept this observation.

superseded.label: Superseded evidence
superseded.description: A later observation replaced this fact for current evaluation. It remains immutable and visible for historical reconstruction.

processing.title: Evidence pipeline needs attention
processing.description: These are server-recorded processing failures for this candidate. Existing observations remain immutable while the failed input stays retryable.
processing.evaluationRecovery: Request another evaluation from Candidate Readiness after checking the evidence and policy inputs.

codes.testRunUnavailable: A linked test run referenced by this candidate is no longer available to the evidence producer.
codes.invalidSourceData: The source data violates the native evidence contract and cannot be materialized safely.
codes.nativeMaterializationFailed: The native evidence producer could not materialize this source revision. The input remains queued for retry.
codes.evaluationRetriesExhausted: Automatic policy evaluation exhausted its bounded retries for the current evidence revision.
codes.evaluationFailed: Policy evaluation failed for the current candidate input. The recorded failure code is shown above.

history.title: Decision history
history.empty: No readiness decisions have been recorded yet.
history.summary: Policy v{{version}} · evidence revision {{revision}} · {{count}} gates need attention

decisionDetail.contextMismatchTitle: Decision does not belong to this candidate
decisionDetail.contextMismatchDescription: The decision URL does not match the selected release candidate.
decisionDetail.title: Readiness decision detail
decisionDetail.immutableDescription: Policy inputs, evaluated gates, evidence revision, and computed status are preserved exactly. A waiver can change only the effective disposition.
decisionDetail.gatesSnapshot: Values captured by this exact evaluation.

waivers.title: Waivers and approvals
waivers.immutableNote: Waivers are append-only and never turn a failed gate green.
waivers.readyDescription: This decision is already ready and does not require a waiver.
waivers.readOnlyDescription: Only workspace owners, administrators, and leads can create or revoke waivers.
waivers.exceptionWarning: You are recording an attributable exception to the computed decision. The original status remains unchanged.
waivers.gateRequired: Select the exact gate evaluation to waive.
waivers.reasonHint: Explain the accepted risk and why this exception is appropriate.
waivers.reasonRequired: Enter a reason for this audited action.
waivers.expiryHint: Optional. Expiry must be in the future.
waivers.expiryInvalid: Choose a valid expiry in the future.
waivers.externalApprovalHint: Optional ticket, change request, or approval identifier.
waivers.noAvailableTargets: Every eligible target already has an active waiver.
waivers.empty: No waivers have been recorded for this decision.
